title: EldRecord
description: Canonical record shared by firmware (comms/protocol.rs + app.rs envelope), phone-relay (src/storage.ts EldRecord) and ingest-server (src/model.rs Envelope). Dedup identity is (device_id, seq). See docs/ingest-contract.md.

seq.description: (boot_epoch << 30) | counter: 23-bit boot epoch over a 30-bit counter, 53 bits total so it stays exact in JavaScript (<= 2^53 - 1) and below the Postgres BIGINT maximum; monotonic per device.

ts_ms.description: UTC Unix epoch ms, or null until GPS time is trusted. Never uptime disguised as UTC.

monotonic_ms.description: Milliseconds since boot; optional only for records queued by older firmware.
